summary: This Best Current Practice document compiles the process for selecting, confirming, and recalling members of the IAB and IESG, and some members of the IAOC, through nominating and recall committees. It was replaced by RFC 8713.

eli5.summary: The groups that guide the internet need new members. This document is the rulebook for how a committee picks them and how they can be removed. It was replaced by RFC 8713.

questions: how are iab and iesg members selected
